examples.note: AES-256 is a drop-in replacement for AES-128 in the same library — only the key size changes (16 bytes -> 32 bytes). No new library or API shape is needed, unlike the asymmetric algorithm migrations.

While migrating the key size, also flag ECB mode as insecure regardless of key size (it leaks structural patterns in the plaintext) — GCM provides both confidentiality and integrity and is the modern default.
